efficiency.policy: Measure alternating binary samples before match jobs; verify fixed-depth trees are identical. This suite was used to validate PGO tree equivalence, not to train its counters. Performance metrics do not establish Elo.

policy: Fixed caps declared before any match result. No early stopping, no PGO parameter retuning from match results. Archive every result. Historical books already used in previous series and root-only tests, not fresh external opening families. No CPU-native or combined PGO/root strength claim.
